senses.definition: Tested, hence, proven to be firm or reliable.
(law) Put on trial, taken before a lawcourt.
simple past and past participle of try

quotes.text: The boy became volubly friendly and bubbling over with unexpected humour and high spirits. He tried to persuade Cicely to stay away from the ball-room for a fourth dance. Nobody would miss them, he explained.
